name: com.thiscar/inventory
title: THIScar Inventory
description: Search THIScar's live used-car inventory, get vehicle details, and find store hours.

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Search THIScar's live used-car inventory in plain words, e.g. "AWD SUV under $32k", "third-row SUV with low miles", "2021 Toyota Tacoma" or "Honda Civic". Returns up to 6 currently listed vehicles with no-haggle price, mileage, key specs and links to the listing and test-drive booking. Check each result against every requirement the shopper gave; the search may relax constraints when nothing matches exactly (relaxedSearch=true).

query.description: What the shopper wants: make/model, budget, body style, drivetrain, mileage, year, features.

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: Get full current details for one THIScar vehicle by VIN or stock number: no-haggle price, mileage, specs, listed equipment, NHTSA safety rating (when verified), the store that has it, and links to the listing, vehicle history report and test-drive booking.

stockNumber.description: THIScar stock number, as shown on the listing.

tools.name: get_locations
tools.description: List THIScar locations with address, phone and regular weekly hours (Central time). Only the sales showroom (Tomball) sells cars and has cars to see and test drive; every other location is a buying center that only buys cars from people selling theirs.
